title_zh: 条件式 P0 全停门首启单元
title_en: Conditional P0 All-Stop Gate launch unit
scope_note_zh: 本文件将 P0 绑定到众智园临时重点区与安全慢速场的参与者首选筛查关系，但仍无坐标、不可放样、不可采购。它不替代测绘、正式选址、工程设计、专业签章、许可、报价或现场验收。
scope_note_en: This file binds P0 to a participant-preferred screening relationship with the provisional Zhongzhiyuan key area and safe-speed yard, but still has no set-out coordinates and cannot be procured. It does not replace survey, formal siting, engineering design, professional sign-off, permission, quotation, or field acceptance.

scales.purpose_zh: 筛查与遗产铁路、既有慢行道、社区界面、绿化缓冲和潜在服务支路的关系
scales.purpose_en: Screen the relationship to heritage rail, existing slow route, community edge, green buffer, and a possible service spur

scales.purpose_zh: 核验净宽、回转、值守视线、机器人停止与构件退距
scales.purpose_en: Check clear width, turning, staffed sightline, robot stopping, and component setbacks

scales.purpose_zh: 核验慢行、触觉/高对比边界、服务区、维护和拆除净空的断面关系
scales.purpose_en: Check the section relationship among slow travel, tactile/high-contrast edge, service zone, maintenance, and removal clearance

scales.purpose_zh: 核验可逆铺装、压重底座、线缆、照明与排水接口的可撤回逻辑
scales.purpose_en: Check the reversible surface, weighted base, cable, lighting, and drainage interface

dimensions.basis_zh: 用于比较既有路径、服务区与拆除通道是否能同时容纳的设计假设；不是地块面积或现场实测。
dimensions.basis_en: Design assumption used to test whether the existing route, service zone, and removal access can coexist; not a parcel area or field measurement.
dimensions.trigger: candidate site nominated and rights holder permits baseline survey

dimensions.derivation: 12.0 m x 8.0 m service apron within the screening envelope
dimensions.basis_zh: 用于不破坏原地面的可拆铺装、标线和服务构件布置；现场材料相容性与排水仍为 TBC。
dimensions.basis_en: Allows demountable surfacing, markings, and service components without assuming ground alteration; material compatibility and drainage remain TBC.
dimensions.trigger: surface, level and drainage baseline complete

dimensions.derivation: continuous 18.0 m x 3.0 m unobstructed strip
dimensions.basis_zh: 为轮椅、陪同行人与低速会车留出保守操作余量的设计假设；不声称等于法定最小值，须由无障碍、交通和消防角色按现场标准复核。
dimensions.basis_en: Conservative operating assumption allowing a wheelchair, companion, and low-speed passing; not claimed as a statutory minimum and subject to accessibility, traffic, and fire review.
dimensions.trigger: measured cross-section and applicable public standards confirmed

dimensions.derivation: one clear circle at the service decision point and one at the staffed desk
dimensions.basis_zh: 用于概念平面避免以最小设备尺寸挤压回转的设计假设；最终形状与数值由付费共同设计和无障碍专业复核。
dimensions.basis_en: Concept-plan assumption preventing equipment from consuming turning space; final shape and value require paid co-design and accessibility review.
dimensions.trigger: co-design mock-up and measured route test

dimensions.derivation: 2.4 m x 0.8 m demountable module; accessible approach and counter height TBC
dimensions.basis_zh: 长度用于容纳纸本、人工办理和急停控制的分区；台面高度、膝部净空和设备型号不得在无障碍复核前冻结。
dimensions.basis_en: Length separates paper information, staffed service, and stop control; counter height, knee clearance, and equipment model cannot be frozen before accessibility review.

dimensions.derivation: unobstructed concept sight triangle from desk to both route entries and robot stop line
dimensions.basis_zh: 用于平面筛查的最大观察距离假设，不是人员响应承诺；遮挡、夜间和真实响应时间必须现场测试。
dimensions.basis_en: Maximum concept observation-distance assumption for plan screening, not a response-time promise; obstruction, night conditions, and actual response require field testing.

dimensions.basis_zh: 仅用于最坏包络筛查，不对应具体设备；设备外廓、制动、救援和充电条件均为 TBC。
dimensions.basis_en: Worst-envelope screening only and not tied to a device; device dimensions, braking, rescue, and charging remain TBC.
dimensions.trigger: specific equipment and controlled test protocol proposed

dimensions.derivation: 3.2 m x 2.0 m buffer between 3.2 m stop line and slow route
dimensions.basis_zh: 在算法判断之外提供可见物理边界的设计假设；最终停止距离由受控测试和安全专业方确认，只能增大不能在未复核时缩小。
dimensions.basis_en: Visible physical boundary independent of algorithmic judgment; final stopping distance is set through controlled testing and safety review and cannot be reduced without evidence.
dimensions.trigger: braking and rescue test passed in a contained site

dimensions.derivation: minimum concept furniture/equipment/sign setback outside the 3.0 m clear strip
dimensions.basis_zh: 避免设备、座椅和标识侵入净宽的筛查值；触觉/高对比边界属于路径接口，不按普通家具处理，做法为 TBC。
dimensions.basis_en: Screening value keeping equipment, seating, and signs outside the clear strip; tactile/high-contrast edges are route interfaces, not furniture, and remain TBC in detail.

dimensions.derivation: clear working band around demountable frame and equipment cabinet
dimensions.basis_zh: 供人工检查、搬运和无损拆除的概念余量；不能占用慢行净宽或既有应急路径。
dimensions.basis_en: Concept allowance for inspection, handling, and non-destructive removal; it cannot consume the slow-route width or any existing emergency route.
dimensions.trigger: installation and removal method statement reviewed

dimensions.derivation: one 3.0 m clear concept route to the screening-envelope edge
dimensions.basis_zh: 按最大可拆模块的人工/小型搬运筛查，不授权车辆进入；实际应急和搬运净宽由现场管理、消防与安装方确认。
dimensions.basis_en: Screens manual or small-plant removal of the largest demountable module and does not authorize vehicle access; actual emergency and handling width requires site-management, fire, and installer confirmation.

dimensions.derivation: 4.8 m x 3.6 m weighted-base canopy; 2.4 m concept clear height
dimensions.basis_zh: 只用于平面、断面和工程量计算；风、雪、结构、净高、文保、消防和基础承载均为 TBC，未签放不得安装。
dimensions.basis_en: For plan, section, and quantity calculation only; wind, snow, structure, clearance, heritage, fire, and bearing capacity remain TBC and installation is prohibited before sign-off.

tbc_interfaces.trigger: applicable standard and full-size mock-up confirmed
night baseline and electrical capacity verified
measured emergency baseline and fire review

roles.authority: coordinates tasks and evidence; cannot self-authorize opening

roles.role_zh: 场地权利方/委托责任槽位
roles.authority: accountable for final release, removal instruction, ground-restoration acceptance, and records retention; release depends on all required professional evidence

roles.role_zh: 付费无障碍共同设计牵头人
roles.authority: may place the work on immediate HOLD for exclusion, inaccessible equivalence, or safeguarding failure

roles.role_zh: 人工服务与接管运营角色
roles.authority: executes staffed equivalent service, immediate takeover, opening/closing parity, and may stop operation

roles.role_zh: 当班安全/隐私专业角色
roles.authority: independent immediate stop authority; controls incident scene and evidence preservation

roles.role_zh: 可拆构件安装与恢复角色
roles.authority: installs, maintains, dismantles, removes waste, restores the surface, and submits as-left records

roles.role_zh: 独立无障碍/运行评估角色
roles.authority: observes without operating the pilot; signs evidence completeness, not government or engineering approval

roles.role_zh: 测绘与基线记录专业角色
roles.authority: records levels, obstacles, condition, utilities and reinstatement reference only after authorization
reviews route, turning, tactile, contrast, counter and same-task equivalence; may require redesign or HOLD

roles.role_zh: 交通与慢行接口复核角色
roles.authority: reviews pedestrian, cycle, curb, logistics and conflict conditions without authorizing road use

roles.role_zh: 消防与应急通道复核角色
roles.authority: may stop any proposal that reduces an existing emergency route or lacks an accepted emergency method

roles.role_zh: 结构与临时构件复核角色
roles.authority: reviews wind, snow, bearing, fixing, clearance and dismantling before any assembly release

roles.role_zh: 电气、照明与隔离复核角色
roles.authority: reviews capacity, cable protection, isolation, lighting and safe shutdown

roles.role_zh: 地面、标高与排水复核角色
roles.authority: reviews levels, ponding, outfall, wet-weather access and restoration baseline

roles.role_zh: 设备停止、救援与接口角色
roles.role_en: Equipment stop, rescue, and interface reviewer
roles.authority: defines contained stop, braking, rescue, charging and isolation evidence for any nominated equipment

roles.role_zh: 照明与视觉可读性复核角色
roles.authority: reviews task lighting, glare, contrast and day/night readability with affected users
owns inspection windows, spares, defect closure and maintenance-to-removal escalation

immediate_stop_rule.public_activation: any user or worker may activate a visible physical stop without penalty; restart requires recorded cause, correction, and accountable release
immediate_stop_rule.non_compensation_rule: any safety-critical group failure, missing equivalent service, or failed exit places the whole unit on HOLD; averages cannot compensate

input_conditions: all role slots remain unassigned until accepted in writing
recovery_or_exit_evidence: dated role acceptance or written no-go

hold_conditions: existing slow route or emergency route narrowed

recovery_or_exit_evidence: sealed baseline dataset by appointed professional

hold_conditions: desk cannot see route entries and stop line
AI can open while human service is closed
recovery_or_exit_evidence: recorded withdrawal if equivalence cannot be staffed

outputs: rate-null cost workbook and restoration reserve requirement
wheelchair turn and desk approach check
hold_conditions: defect lacks owner or closure evidence

recovery_or_exit_evidence: qualified/failed evaluation with unresolved items visible

input_conditions: planned end of window or immediate removal instruction
recovery_or_exit_evidence: remediation invoice/record with rates redacted or TBC as applicable
signed acceptance by accountable role and independent evidence reviewer

boq.derivation: adjacent to staffed desk and outside clear route
2 entries + 1 staffed desk + 1 robot stop + 1 exit/restoration notice
one continuous route-edge interface; detailed pattern TBC

boq.item_zh: 机器人不可进入区标识

boq.derivation: 3 movable seats and 1 unoccupied companion bay under/near shelter
plan-count only; illuminance, glare and power TBC
1 lockable cabinet + 2 protected power/data points; capacities TBC
ceil(90 days / 7); daily pre-open checks depend on authorized open days

boq.item_zh: 拆除、清运、地面恢复与验收
boq.item_en: Dismantling, removal, ground restoration, and acceptance
boq.derivation: remove all P0 objects + before/after condition comparison + acceptance

cost_model.formula: C_P0 = C_REV + C_HUMAN + C_CODESIGN + C_ACCESS_SAFETY + C_PRIVACY_EVAL + C_OM + C_REMOVE_RESTORE + C_RESERVE

components.formula: sum(BOQ quantity_i x verified unit_rate_i) + installation labour
H_open x r_staff + H_training x r_staff + H_supervision x r_supervisor
N_participants x H_participant x r_participant + access_support + travel + care
H_access x r_access + H_safety x r_safety + H_fire x r_fire + H_structure x r_structure
H_privacy x r_privacy + H_independent x r_evaluator
W x visits_per_week x H_visit x r_maint + consumables + utilities + incident_allowance
H_remove x r_remove + A_remediation x r_remediation + waste_trace + acceptance
max(verified C_REMOVE_RESTORE, p_contingency x subtotal); p_contingency TBC by cost/risk professionals

cost_model.staffing_formula: FTE_required = annual staffed hours / 1680 productive hours x 1.2 leave-training factor
sensitivity_variables: paid participant hours and access support
cost_model.release_condition: No procurement or budget claim until quantities are checked against a nominated site, every market rate has a source and basis date, roles are assigned, and restoration reserve is ring-fenced.

acceptance_current_package.formula: connected entry-to-exit route pairs / 1 required pair
acceptance_current_package.data_source: 1:100 concept graph in key-areas figure + v13 source

acceptance_current_package.formula: count(BOQ objects intersecting the 18.0 m x 3.0 m clear route)
scenario cards with a stated non-AI equivalent / 12 scenario cards
synthetic tasks with complete audit record / 12 tasks
acceptance_current_package.trigger_condition: simulation schema, audit fields, or task set changes

acceptance_current_package.formula: malformed-input tests resulting in HOLD / malformed-input tests

acceptance_current_package.label_zh: AI 关闭后人工任务仍可完成
acceptance_current_package.label_en: Human task remains complete with AI off
acceptance_current_package.formula: AI-off same-task cases completed through staffed/paper/phone/fixed spatial paths / 12 tasks
acceptance_current_package.trigger_condition: service window, hot-backup rule, or task set changes

acceptance_current_package.threshold_status: SET: 6/6 specified; execution remains field HOLD
acceptance_current_package.trigger_condition: removal method or acceptance role change

acceptance_field.formula: successful same-task completions / valid attempts, reported with critical failures
acceptance_field.trigger_condition: G0-G3 pass and group approves protocol

acceptance_field.formula: successful same-task completions / valid attempts, reported with critical failures
acceptance_field.trigger_condition: G0-G3 pass and tactile/audio/contrast interfaces confirmed

acceptance_field.label_zh: 无智能手机老人取得人工服务时间
acceptance_field.label_en: Time for an older person without a smartphone to reach staffed service
acceptance_field.formula: P90(time from envelope entry to confirmed human assistance)
acceptance_field.trigger_condition: staff roster and opening hours confirmed

acceptance_field.formula: P90(time from help request to two-way human response), disaggregated by period
observed conflicts / valid traversals, with every safety-critical event separately reported
baseline and operating sound levels by agreed period/location
measured task/route illuminance plus glare/contrast review at agreed points
acceptance_field.trigger_condition: night access and fixture schedule confirmed

acceptance_field.formula: count of ponding/blockage events plus before/after surface-level and outlet check
acceptance_field.data_source: level survey, rainfall observation, maintenance log

acceptance_field.formula: shade availability and agreed thermal/wind observations by operating period
reported response distribution by affected group; dissent remains visible
acceptance_field.threshold_status: TBC_STAKEHOLDER_PREREGISTRATION; no average may override critical group rejection
acceptance_field.trigger_condition: affected parties and consent protocol confirmed

acceptance_field.formula: staffed equivalent hours delivered / authorized digital-service hours
cost components with verified quantity, unit rate, source, basis date, and payer / 8 components
acceptance_field.data_source: authorized cost plan, quotations, payroll/fees, maintenance and restoration records
acceptance_field.threshold_status: SET: 8/8 evidence fields complete before cost claim; market values remain TBC
acceptance_field.trigger_condition: site, procurement route, rate sources, basis date, and funding authority confirmed

movement_conditions.condition: rights, heritage, emergency, utilities, or drainage conflict cannot be resolved within the envelope
service scope or opening time can be reduced without reducing clear route, equivalent service, maintenance, or exit capacity
movement_conditions.required_evidence: revised dimensions/BOQ/roster + all affected checks rerun

movement_conditions.condition: temporary roster, audit, weather, lighting, maintenance, complaint, or equipment-control gap
movement_conditions.required_evidence: stop log + human takeover + cause/repair/restart decision

movement_conditions.condition: safety-critical failure, missing equivalence, failed exit, repeated unresolved incident, permit withdrawal, or affected-group rejection
planned day-90 end or any removal instruction
movement_conditions.required_evidence: before/after condition comparison + defect closure + accountable acceptance + public close-out
